text: claire: quick heads-up: noticed the onboarding quickstart links to /guides/rapid-serve#kv-tuning but that fragment doesn't exist on the portuguese page (pt/guides/rapid-serve). users land at top of doc and miss the section. can someone from docs or l10n own a tiny fix? rob: can you paste both URLs so I can repro locally? claire: sure: EN: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/guides/rapid-serve#kv-tuning PT: https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/pt/guides/rapid-serve#kvtuning l10n-bot: linkcheck: fragment mismatch detected for /pt/guides/rapid-serve referenced from /guides/rapid-serve. first seen 2025-08-12. sophia: thanks for flagging. localization usually maintains pt pages, but adding an alias anchor is quick and safe. @marco are you on the pt backlog? marco: I can take ownership of the pt fix. prefer not to change english anchors (other pages link to #kv-tuning). i'll add an alias anchor in the pt markdown: `` just above the heading. rob: can you also add a 1-line smoke test to the docs smoke suite? we've been catching these earlier if we assert fragment lands. marco: yes. plan: 1) tiny PR to pt/guides/rapid-serve.md adding anchor, 2) add a curl-based smoke check in docs-smoke that asserts final URL includes `#kv-tuning` or 200 + fragment resolves. will tag @docs-ci in PR. claire: example sed I used to test locally: ```bash # insert hidden anchor before heading awk '/^#+ KV cache tuning/{print ""}1' pt/guides/rapid-serve.md > tmp && mv tmp pt/guides/rapid-serve.md # smoke: expect 200 and landing url with fragment preserved (server may redirect) curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{url_effective}" "https://internal.docs.redwood.ai/pt/guides/rapid-serve#kv-tuning" ``` rob: perfect. docs-ci: when adding the smoke test please gate it so it's cheap (single curl) and only runs for changed pages. docs-ci: noted. we'll accept a microtest that runs under smoke/quickchecks for page-level anchor checks. cc @docs-infra for frontmatter/redirect concerns. marco: PR opened: #4182-pt-anchor-alias + smoke. requesting review from sophia and rob. I'll also add a one-line KB note under /kb/guide-fragment-drift so localization teams get pinged during bulk backports. sophia: thanks marco. small ask: add a comment in the PR linking the l10n ticket ID so translators see the change. claire: thanks all. filing a quick internal note so we can spot similar casing/underscore drift during translation handoffs. :memo:
